decisions.reason: Having already been kept after its first year and fitting directly into the firm's core coolant-management and innovation strategy, management would be reluctant to reverse course unless results clearly deteriorate.
As a multi-model extension of the established coolant portfolio that can be bundled into wider system sales, the firm is likely to continue supporting it rather than admit a misstep.

Although somewhat less central than the core coolant products, it still supports the announced automation and material-flow direction, so prior investment and public offering make withdrawal unlikely this soon.
Because it builds on the firm's established chip-handling business and reinforces a broad systems offering, escalation of commitment points to continued market presence.

Even as a close-adjacent rather than fully core product, it remains consistent with the firm's conveying portfolio and a large German machinery producer would usually give such a launch more time before dropping it.
